view.view_resource_source_formula: FPackedView: SVPositionToTranslatedWorld 0, ViewToTranslatedWorld 64, TranslatedWorldToView 128, TranslatedWorldToClip 192, ViewToClip 256, ClipToRelativeWorld 320, prev matrices 384..576, ViewRect 640, ViewSizeAndInvSize 656 (NaniteShared.h:59-72)
view.allocation_source: ResourceDescs GBufferA/B/C/D/F, SceneColor, SceneDepthZ, ShadowMaskTexture = 1280x888; presented view rect = 1280x720
view.matrix_convention: captured four float4 groups applied as out[j]=sum_i v[i]*groups[i][j]; both ClipToTranslatedWorld and SVPositionToTranslatedWorld routes agree at all receivers
view.offset_192_identity: TranslatedWorldToClip per NaniteShared.h:59-72; it is NOT TranslatedWorldToView and is not used as the view matrix

gbuffer_a.name: GBufferA
gbuffer_a.channels: R10G10B10A2 little-endian word: R bits0-9, G bits10-19, B bits20-29, A bits30-31

gbuffer_c.name: GBufferC
gbuffer_c.formula: BaseColor_linear = sRGB_EOTF(mem[2]/255), sRGB_EOTF(mem[1]/255), sRGB_EOTF(mem[0]/255); sRGB_EOTF(c)=c/12.92 if c<=0.04045 else ((c+0.055)/1.055)^2.4; AO=mem[3]/255

gbuffer_d.name: GBufferD
gbuffer_d.formula: opaque per-material CustomData; all zero at the reported receivers

gbuffer_f.name: GBufferF
gbuffer_f.channels: memory B,G,R,A; world tangent RGB + anisotropy A when the material is anisotropic
gbuffer_f.formula: not used: the captured shading model is DefaultLit (id 1) and the receiver materials are not anisotropic

scene_depth.name: SceneDepthZ
scene_depth.channels: single float device Z; native target PF_DepthStencil; readback decoded to float32
scene_depth.formula: W = D*InvDeviceZToWorldZTransform[0] + [1] + 1/(D*[2] - [3]); reversed-Z, deviceZ=0 is sky/far

scene_color_pre.name: SceneColor
scene_color_pre.formula: pre-direct SceneColor; exact half values reported

scene_color_post.name: SceneColor
scene_color_post.formula: post-direct SceneColor; direct term = post - pre (RGB)

vsm_shadow_mask.name: ShadowMaskTexture
vsm_shadow_mask.channels: memory B,G,R,A; shader .r/.g carry sqrt(shadow factor), target clear white; .b/.a remain clear white
vsm_shadow_mask.formula: OutShadowMask = sqrt(float4(shadow.x, shadow.y, shadow.x, shadow.y)); consumed as LightAttenuationTexture; shadow_linear = (mem[2]/255)^2

shadow_mask.formula: OutShadowMask = sqrt(float4(shadow.x, shadow.y, shadow.x, shadow.y)); consumed as LightAttenuationTexture; shadow_linear = (mem[2]/255)^2

direct.definition: post SceneColor(pass 842) - pre SceneColor(pass 840), RGB; actual captured additive sun pass, not an analytic BRDF or AS/SMRT intermediate
